risks.title: Auditorium double-booked
risks.cause: The auditorium is shared with other departments
risks.event: Another event is given the same date
risks.effect: Venue must be re-arranged and posters reprinted
risks.response: Get the booking confirmed in writing by the dean's office

risks.title: Sponsor money arrives late
risks.cause: Sponsors pay only after receiving a signed invoice
risks.event: Advance for sound and lighting cannot be paid on time
risks.response: Send invoices the day sponsors confirm and ask the department for a small advance

risks.title: Volunteers drop out
risks.cause: Volunteers have internal exams the same week
risks.response: Recruit 20 percent more volunteers than needed
